s.brief: Tier shelf: everyday recurring contracts that keep a home running. For each kind list the market-covering operators/franchises by major market (US, UK, EU, Australia) plus test or survey winners (Which?, Consumer Reports, CHOICE) where they exist, ≈5–10 per kind; frequency and plan levels as t. Candidates to verify (not facts): cleaning – Molly Maid, Merry Maids, The Maids, Helpling, Housekeep; laundry – Laundryheap, Rinse, Oxwash; lawn and garden – TruGreen, Green Thumb; pest control – Rentokil, Terminix, Orkin; home and appliance cover – HomeServe, British Gas HomeCare, Domestic & General, American Home Shield; alarm monitoring – ADT, Verisure/Securitas Direct, SimpliSafe, Vivint, Ring Protect. Boundaries: alarm kits, cameras and sensors stay in B8 (only the monitoring contract is here); a hot tub itself is G3; personal medical alarms stay in H2. No archetypes needed; plain definitions. Source each kind from a retrieved page (Wikipedia article, trade body, regulator or operator page). Operators go in m/r as market-covering firms by country; brand-register entries only if sourced. One-off jobs (a single deep clean, removals, a single repair, a one-off ride or charter) are OUT per BRIEF; only recurring contracts, retainers and memberships.
